updates.title: CVE-2026-49179: Windows Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution
updates.summary: A command injection vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code remotely over the network. This is a critical security issue affecting identity infrastructure that admins must patch immediately.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62827: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An improper authentication flaw in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to escalate their privileges over the network. Organizations managing sensitive content in SharePoint should apply patches to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-63512: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: An incorrect authorization control in SharePoint enables authorized attackers to tamper with content and data over the network. This impacts data integrity and requires timely remediation to prevent unauthorized modifications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging for the Purview portal will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping admins troubleshoot authorization issues and monitor who can access what. This improvement directly supports compliance audits and access governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: DLP policies can now automatically move sensitive files to a restricted, admin-controlled quarantine location when triggered, immediately revoking user access while preserving the file for review. This provides stronger enforcement and faster incident response for data exposure risks.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Tips and Email Notifications Decoupling
updates.summary: Admins can now independently configure policy tips and email notifications for SharePoint and OneDrive DLP rules, rather than enabling both together. This granular control allows organizations to tailor user communication and policy enforcement separately.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Actionable Email Notifications for Incident Remediation
updates.summary: End users can now remediate DLP policy violations directly from email notifications without leaving their mailbox, with actions including stopping file sharing, deletion, labeling, policy override, and false positive reporting. This streamlines remediation workflows and reduces mean time to resolution.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery Customer-Managed Key for Direct Export
updates.summary: eDiscovery administrators can now manage their own encryption keys for direct export workflows, adding customer-controlled encryption alongside Microsoft-managed options. This enhances security posture for organizations handling highly sensitive discovery data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery Advanced Review Set Explorer
updates.summary: A new analytics tool for eDiscovery reviewers enables real-time big data analysis on review sets using Kusto queries, allowing identification of data patterns, item types, and trends with flexible charting. This accelerates case analysis and insight discovery for legal and compliance teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery In-Product Diagnostics
updates.summary: Self-service diagnostics now help eDiscovery admins identify and resolve common configuration issues related to case permissions, security filters, and policy status. This reduces support tickets and enables faster troubleshooting of access and authorization problems.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery SharePoint Embedded Container as Data Source
updates.summary: eDiscovery users can now discover and select SharePoint Embedded containers (used by Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks) owned by specific individuals as data sources. This extends eDiscovery coverage to modern collaboration and AI-generated content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Data Security Triage Agent Summaries in Defender XDR
updates.summary: DLP alert summaries and categorizations generated by the Data Security Triage Agent will now appear in Microsoft Defender XDR's DLP Alerts view. This integration improves alert context and investigation efficiency for security teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery Hold Reports
updates.summary: eDiscovery Premium now offers out-of-the-box reports displaying all legal holds associated with cases, with sorting, filtering, and export capabilities. This simplifies hold management oversight and audit documentation for compliance and legal teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels Simulation Mode for Auto-Labeling
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode before enforcement, allowing admins to preview which items would be labeled and review match results without making changes. This reduces unintended labeling and enables confident policy rollout.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now combines Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list, allowing analysts to view and manage both alert types from one location with agent summaries and user details. This improves alert triage efficiency and reduces context switching.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Expanded User Profile Signals
updates.summary: The Insider Risk unified alert experience now displays enriched user profile data from Microsoft Entra, including office location, employee type, department, and last working date. Enhanced context enables more informed risk assessment during alert investigation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP can now integrate with Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, preventing sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud apps and AI platforms. This extends DLP protection beyond traditional endpoints to API and network traffic.
